hypothesis: For single peptide substitutions, a receptor-context contrast of PepMLM masked marginal log-odds may separate target-dependent preferences from context-insensitive sequence preferences. It is a candidate proposal signal, not calibrated affinity.
why_distinct_from_current_pipeline: Current guided arm selects positions by contact-count-weighted static GraphPep residue feedback, then samples PepMLM; the new proposal evaluates site-and-amino-acid jointly and includes a receptor-context ablation.

formula.d_R_i_a: log p_PepMLM(a | R, P masked only at i) - log p_PepMLM(P_i | R, P masked only at i)
formula.null_controls: Two fixed composition-preserving receptor permutations; artificial technical controls, not affinity negatives.
formula.units: natural-log units, not kcal/mol, Kd, or binding deltaG

stage1_technical_contract.per_mask_outputs: One model distribution gives all 20 standard amino-acid logits. It is not 19 separate structure predictions.
method_arms: existing static GraphPep position ranking (reuse only)
uniform random ranking over the exact same eligible sites and amino-acid pool
stage1_technical_contract.historical_label_exposure: All MDM2/PMI data are DEVELOPMENT. No fitting or threshold selection using known affinity directions; no rerun of P27A. Existing counterexamples are not a fresh test set.
stage1_technical_contract.scope_of_comparison: Correct indexing, numerical consistency, dependence on receptor order, control disagreement and candidate coverage; no affinity direction accuracy is calculated in stage 1.
stage1_technical_contract.precision: Proposed FP32 inference, eval mode, no gradients, TF32 disabled, batch size <=2. No precision fallback on OOM.
stage1_technical_contract.suggestion_filter: d_target, H_against_control_1 and H_against_control_2 must each exceed the numeric tolerance. Otherwise abstain; never resample controls to force recommendations.
stage1_technical_contract.ranking: Among eligible substitutions passing the filter, rank by H descending; one top suggestion per site, at most six distinct single-substitution suggestions per parent. No physical candidates or structures are generated in stage 1.
stage1_technical_contract.cache_policy: Do not use the old peptide-sequence-only PPL cache across contexts. Use fresh outputs in a new directory or a key containing checkpoint, receptor, peptide, masked position, precision and scoring definition.
stops: nonfinite logits or bad mask indexing
WT-to-WT difference not zero within tolerance
interpretation: If all receptor-context effects are at numerical tolerance, the proposed context signal is not demonstrated for these inputs; HOLD expansion.
If controls disagree, report it and abstain on the affected substitution.
If no suggestions remain, report zero coverage; do not change controls or thresholds to rescue.
Passing technical checks only means the prototype runs and has interpretable context sensitivity. It does not validate affinity, specificity, novelty or feedback superiority.

stage2_affinity_validation.baseline_policy: Keep GraphPep, FoldX, ESM2 and contact features as peer candidate methods; compare H and unadjusted d on exactly the same eligible experimental labels. Preserve their frozen 0.05 tie bands.
stage2_affinity_validation.new_method_ties: Numeric zero/tie rule must be frozen in the new protocol; it is not a biologically calibrated effect-size threshold.
stage2_affinity_validation.metrics: Use frozen within-system/background-balanced direction accuracy, both class recalls, coverage and all failures/ties. Paired uncertainty for the method difference must be reported; no superiority claim if inconclusive.
stage2_affinity_validation.data_floor: At least 10 eligible pairs, at least four in each direction and at least two parent backgrounds for a full single-system signal; engineering pilots do not replace this.
stage2_affinity_validation.falsifier: A sufficiently qualified panel that shows H failing the frozen signal gate or failing to add useful evidence beyond unadjusted d does not support the context-correction hypothesis. Do not tune on its errors and call that same panel independent.
stage2_affinity_validation.structure_branch: Any given-experimental-pose scoring has separate source/mapping/validation gates. Experimental PDB inputs do not require AFM ipTM/PAE; old AFM failures remain unchanged.
stage2_affinity_validation.data_work_budget: At most one hour of targeted review of already identified missing inputs/labels. Reuse local SKEMPI and existing source reports. No duplicate SI downloads, broad database expansion, contact, payment or wet lab.

stage3_closed_loop.future_design: Same eligible site pool, one mutation per child, identical proposal/sequence budgets, matched random plus unadjusted-PepMLM ablation, fixed structural/reward evaluation. Re-evaluation by the same optimizing score alone is not proof of improved binding.

alternatives_considered.tradeoff: Uses experimental poses directly, but current model failures cannot be repaired just by another matched-difference formula; additional modeling/labels needed.
Recommended first technical falsification: no training, no new weights or folding; artificial null contexts may be out of distribution and must be tested as an ablation.

alternatives_considered.approach: Train a new GNN or end-to-end generator
alternatives_considered.tradeoff: Deferred: current independently qualified labels do not justify model capacity or evaluation claims.

novelty: Masked log-odds and contrastive ideas have prior literature. This is a project hypothesis/prototype proposal, not a verified novel algorithm.
